## Core Product Lines & Wholesale Catalogs
- [Product Catalog](https://theprintplanet.co.in/products): Complete list of 100+ wholesale ID card accessories and machines.
- [Category Directory](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories): Grouped wholesale inventory by category.
- [Satin Lanyard Rolls](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/white-satin-digital-lanyard-roll): 12mm, 16mm, 20mm, 25mm rolls for sublimation heat transfer.
- [PVC ID Card Holders](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/semi-transparent-pvc-id-card-holder): Vertical and horizontal crystal-clear and frosted card holders.
- [Metal Lanyard Hardware](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/id-card-lanyard-hooks): Dog hooks, oval fish hooks, alligator clips, and metal clamps.
- [ID Card Machinery](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/id-card-manufacturing-machines): Motorized PVC card die cutters and fusing machines.
- [RFID & Smart Cards](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/rfid-smart-cards-and-consumables): Mifare 1K 13.56MHz and EM-Marin 125kHz access cards.
- [Online Quotation Portal](https://theprintplanet.co.in/quote): Instant wholesale B2B price quote request tool.
- [Contact & Factory Location](https://theprintplanet.co.in/contact): Direct address and phone support.

## Ordering & Delivery Information
- **Minimum Order Quantities:** Available in bulk roll packs (typically 100m–500m rolls) and box packaging (100–1,000 units).
- **Logistics & Pan-India Dispatch:** Fast 24–48h shipment via DTDC, Blue Dart, VRL, and TCI.
- **Billing:** 100% compliant GST invoices issued for all commercial orders.
